topics.title: John's Nervous Record Producer
topics.summary: During an interview, John nervously discusses his attempts to secure a record deal with a producer. The conversation quickly devolves into tangents involving baby care advice, musical criticism of Bon Jovi and other artists, and bizarre scenarios like stealing a baby.

topics.title: Leona Helmsley and the Jewish Chorus
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Howard Stern and Robin Quivers discuss their bizarre encounter with Leona Helmsley at her hotel. They recount interactions including an impromptu performance of 'Oh My Gun’ll Had A Farm,' attempts to engage her in conversation about alleged liquor kickbacks, and a chaotic exchange involving a failing Jewish chorus audition and Stern's frustration.

topics.title: New York City Gay Men's Chorus Season Plans
topics.summary: The New York City Gay Men’s Chorus announces plans for the upcoming season, following a vacation in Seattle and the Gayla Choral Festival. Members are encouraged to join the mailing list for updates on performances at Carnegie Hall in December and details about their tenth anniversary season.

He describes numerous callers expressing interest in the tape, detailing his perceived ‘coolness,’ and recounting outlandish anecdotes including celebrity encounters, a dial-a-mattress service, multiple women vying for attention after seeing the footage.
